title: Channel 7 Pressures PIO on Public Update

fields.subject: FW: Is the release over? Live in 5
fields.note: From the Channel 7 newsdesk to the PIO: Channel 7 is at Gate 3 again. The plant has not updated the public since 11:00 and the school says it does not know when the children can go home. Is the release over? Is the air safe? Was this a hack? We go live in 5 minutes.

snapshot.title: Channel 7 Pressures PIO on Public Update

fields.subject: FW: [URGENT] TVCC Restart — Why No Public Update? — 13:45
fields.note: Janelle, Channel 7 is on-site again. We’ve just seen the ERT exit the site and the scale WT-302 is still at 38.1 tons. The plant hasn’t issued a public update since 11:00, and the school district says they’re still not told if it’s safe to reopen. We need a statement now — we’re going live in 5 minutes. Is the release over? Is the system safe? Are they restarting?
